shared_elements: single dominant anthropomorphic/figural form filling the field
circle or disc motif on the torso area
incised linear bands/horizontal divisions across the body
justification: Both are stone carvings dominated by a single figure whose torso carries incised bands and roundel/disc motifs, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a crisp, flat, profile-view low relief filling a rectangular slab with dense ornamental detail, while B is a heavily eroded, frontal, fully three-dimensional block with only faint, coarse markings, so the manner of rendering and the viewing scheme differ fundamentally.
